scenarios.prompt: A player remaps semantic actions, converts a long hold to toggle, enables reduced flash and increases text scale. Define scoped preferences without changing hidden hitboxes.

criteria.input: Semantic action remap, hold/toggle and supported digital alternatives are explicit.
criteria.presentation: Text/color/flash/motion/audio preferences retain required information through supported alternatives.
criteria.evidence: Capability matrix records supported/unsupported combinations and preferences persist.
